topic: Handling commercial supply line calls in older Pittsburgh buildings
hook_options: You are in a basement fixing a supply line and your phone rings.
The plumber who answers gets the job. Not the best one.
We hear the same thing from plumbers all the time: I cannot answer the phone while I am wrenching.
How many commercial calls hit voicemail while you were under a sink today?
Four missed calls from landlords while you were stuck on a job.
